criteria.scope: All product Markdown records, including inactive; no prose extraction, schema defaults, or marketing heuristics. Supplemental structured fountain research joined by exact slug; not yet a category recommendation module.
criteria.coverage: known / all products; explicit false counts as known. partial, unknown and notApplicable are separate. No inference from comparisonData.custom strings, specs, decision or decisionJourney prose.
criteria.readiness: READY = all products have resolved critical fields. PARTIAL = at least one product has all critical fields known/notApplicable/partial. NOT_READY = none does. Critical fields are declared per category before calculation; operational safety and individual fit still require Phase-B validation.
criteria.statusVocabulary: supported=SUPPORTED, unavailable=UNSUPPORTED, partial=PARTIAL, unknown=UNKNOWN, notApplicable=NOT_APPLICABLE; reuse product capability type, no second enum.

filterRequired.source: 35.0B: primary filter required (no main filter = notApplicable)
